reason: E6 shows grain size increases with substrate temperature (14 nm at RT, 38 nm at 250°C, 91 nm at 350°C) and columnar structure at 350°C, but it reports constant film thickness (~975 nm) across temperatures, directly contradicting the premise that increased grain size increases thickness. No cited evidence supports enhanced atomic diffusion as a mechanism for thickness increase.
